annotations.title: Compile & Route PCB in Cloud Enclave

description: Primary full-featured synthesis tool: compile and route a PCB layout (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, .ato, .tsx, or sample_id) in the Calligraphy Cloud Enclave to 100.0% geometric completion with 0 native KiCad copper DRC violations, supporting optional ECO pass, rush turnaround, and inline promo/grant codes. Call this tool after calligraphy_preflight_audit to execute full physical synthesis and mint a job_id. Returns JSON with job_id, status, unlocked, final_price_usd, clickable_stripe_checkout_url, stablecoin_payment_instructions, and agentic_crypto_payment; if IPRateLimitExceededError occurs (3 unpaid compiles/24h per IP), pay an existing job or call calligraphy_request_ip_whitelist.

customer_email.description: Customer engineering email address for job custody receipts, 30-day ECO license matching, and B2B invoicing. Example: 'founder@robotics.io'.

export_control_certified.description: Customer attestation of EAR99 commercial export control compliance and non-sanctioned jurisdiction status (must be true).

filename.description: Filename with extension (.kicad_pcb, .dsn, or .zip) identifying the uploaded CAD format. Example: 'controller_4l.kicad_pcb'.

include_eco_pass.description: Enable +50% 30-Day Unlimited ECO Re-Spin License on 2-layer Maker tiers (included automatically on 4L+ commercial tiers).

no_itar_certified.description: Customer attestation that the uploaded PCB design contains no ITAR-controlled defense articles (must be true).

pcb_text.description: Raw UTF-8 CAD text (.kicad_pcb S-expression, Specctra .dsn, .ato, or .tsx) to synthesize and route to 0 DRC violations.

preserve_existing_copper.description: When true, locks and preserves existing pre-routed copper traces and vias while surgically routing only unrouted or target_nets openings during Rev-B ECO layout updates.

project_path.description: Local filesystem path to a .kicad_pcb or .dsn file (local STDIO mode only) or sample_id alias.

promo_code.description: Optional grant or promo code applied immediately after compilation ('OPENHW' $0 open-hardware grant, 'PROTOTYPE1' $1 pass, 'FOUNDER100' -$100 credit, 'UPGRADE150', 'XBUILDER').

retention_policy.description: Enclave vault retention policy: 'auto_purge_on_download' shreds CAD artifacts immediately upon bundle download; 'expire_24h' retains up to 24 hours.

rush_delivery.description: When true, enables the optional +35% Priority Enclave Rush synthesis queue (<45-minute priority turnaround).

sample_id.description: Built-in demo board ID ('2l_rp2040', '2l_stickhub', or '4l_carrier') for instant synthesis when no custom CAD file is uploaded.

showcase_opt_in.description: Opt in to displaying anonymized raster renders in the public showcase gallery (required when redeeming 'OPENHW').

social_or_repo_url.description: Public HTTPS GitHub repository, X/Twitter, or Reddit URL required when redeeming the 'OPENHW' open-hardware grant. Example: 'https://github.com/org/board'.

target_nets.description: Optional list of specific net names (e.g., ['/I2C_SDA', '/I2C_SCL', 'USB_DP', 'USB_DM']) for surgical Rev-B ECO partial reroutes; empty array routes all unrouted nets.

tos_accepted.description: Explicit acceptance of the Calligraphy Systems Terms of Service and 100% NRE Synthesis Fee Liability Cap (must be true).

upload_b64.description: Base64-encoded binary bytes of a .kicad_pcb, .dsn, or .zip project bundle.
